## JITM POS v1.4.0

### New
- **Shortcuts** — quick-launch tiles on the Home page that open a form with your preset values already filled in (Receipts, Payments, Create Sales Invoice, Create Purchase Invoice). Personal by default; owners/managers can publish business-wide shared shortcuts. Icons via the SVG icon pack — no emojis. Clicking a shortcut always opens a new tab.

### Changed
- **JITM icon pack** — the interface no longer uses emoji glyphs anywhere. All icons are inline SVGs (feather-style): Quick Access tiles, pin buttons, sort/pagination chevrons, sidebar & inventory expanders, print buttons and the POS menu chrome.

No database migration required — the new `shortcuts` table is created automatically on first boot. Backup/restore covers it.
